decisions.reason: The mission-page statement that smart contracts provide automated payouts may still describe contract-controlled payout after a one-click claim, or it may incorrectly imply automatic prize transfer. Revising this copy requires interpretation or a new client wording decision.

Changing prize collection from automatic wallet transfer to a conditional one-click claim does not alter secondary-sale royalty amounts, enforcement, allocations, pool funding, or ticket and commission generation rules.
The source decision changes how a winner collects a prize but does not change the stated transfer behavior of the book, referral code, badges, or active and expired prize tickets.
